summary: Entra Policy Suite Pro and its 60-day trial can now be ordered at invardia.com.

new.title: Pro and the 60-day trial
new.text: Entra Policy Suite Pro and a 60-day trial are now ordered at invardia.com. Pro adds Passkey rollout, Stale identities, License optimization and Policy as code.

new.title: Header shows your edition
new.text: The header now names the edition your licence gives, such as Pro Enterprise or Pro (trial).

fixes.title: License page loads again
fixes.text: Administration > License showed only 'Could not load'. It now lists your edition, state, dates and Pro features.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Pages no longer draw twice while Pro pages load, Stale identities asks for reasons in the app's own dialog, and Pro pages link to their own settings.
